pages.title: Power
pages.text: $(li)Fuel Generator burns rocket fuel.$(li)Gas Generator burns gases.$(li)Wind Turbine only works where there is air.$(li)Solar Wind Panel, by contrast, only works without it.$(li)Hybrid Panel makes twice as much as an advanced one.

pages.title: Protecting a base
pages.text: $(li)Planetary Shield stops meteors.$(li)$(l:space/survival/hazards)Magnetic Field Generator$() protects from radiation.$(li)Gravity Module gives Earth gravity and, with Stabilization, pressure.

pages.title: Hydroponics
pages.text: Power the Hydroponic Base from below and put up to three farm blocks above it. It grows food where normal plants die. A Liquid Collector drains the layer below it, so a base can get water automatically.

pages.title: Farm in a box
pages.text: A base, three farm blocks and power from below.

pages.title: Machines
pages.text: The advanced Circuit Fabricator and Electric Compressor are twice as effective and take Speed and Energy modules. Oxygen and energy clusters hold more, so a base survives longer breaks.

pages.title: Hydroponic Base
pages.text: Powered from below, with the farm on top.

pages.title: Hydroponic Farm Block
pages.text: Put up to three above the base.

pages.title: Liquid Collector
pages.text: Drains the layer of liquid below it.
